facts.fact: The National Bank of Rwanda's Guidelines No 52/2026 of 4 June 2026, in force on signature, require licensed financial institutions to test AI models for bias and discrimination, monitor fairness metrics, keep human review of AI decisions and prohibit unreviewed automated external communications generated by AI.
facts.system: Guidelines No 52/2026 on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management for Financial Institutions

facts.fact: Article 31 of the Guidelines gives the National Bank of Rwanda power to require information, impose corrective actions or sanctions, and require suspension or withdrawal of an AI system or independent audit at the financial institutions it licenses.

systems.system: Guidelines No 52/2026 on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management for Financial Institutions
